long:
Specializing in women’s health and fertility, Tori works with individuals and couples trying to conceive, as well as women with PMOS, endometriosis, and those going through perimenopause or menopause. Her approach focuses on using targeted nutrition strategies to support hormone balance, improve egg and sperm quality, and address underlying factors such as insulin resistance, inflammation, and nutrient deficiencies.

Appointments provided through telehealth.
